title: Heavy Metal and Religion
description: Uses the example of global heavy metal subculture to introduce key conceptual and methodological elements drawn from religious studies, cultural studies and media studies. Questions the category of “religion” while showing it as a useful tool for scholarly inquiry. Considers the impact of new forms of media on religion. Studies lyrics, images, music, fashion, gender dynamics and more.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 323A, ENSH 342 (if taken in the same topic), RCS 310 (if taken in the same topic), RCS 323A.
